memo_delta.stage_one_comment: Amazon remains a name to watch, but we should stop repeating the July explanation for staying out. Its next results showed that AWS was absorbing investment faster than the compression case allowed: the reported and derived quarterly margins both exceed the original early falsification threshold. The recorded profit confirmation test also passed, although the narrower forecast range understated the result. The shares are above the original bull target; that exposes an outcome the scenario set did not span, rather than establishing that the shares are cheap today. We took no Watchlist position, so this is missed upside, not a trading loss. The process lesson comes from the July memo itself: a small bull case and a profit-growth claim tested against consolidated revenue history were weak before the result arrived. Keep watching until earnings and valuation are reassessed. Full-year margins and the longer price forecast are not yet settled. No new numerical conviction is justified by this limited review.
